newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle range mixed at start.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle range mixed at start.

text.p: CME live and feeder cattle futures ranged lightly on both sides of previous levels in initial trade.

Carryover demand in live cattle quickly met profit taking resistance, traders said. Nervous selling was also cited following further losses in boxed beef values while weather concerns continued to provide underlying support. Feeder cattle generally followed active in live cattle.
At 0909 CST, live cattle stood 0.125 to 0.025 cent a lb lower with February off 0.100 at 63.600. Feeder cattle were off 0.150 to 0.100 with January off 0.150 at 66.375 cents.
